title: Decision and experiment sprint
source_note: Research leads supplied by the owner on 2026-09-22. Official notices, eligibility, deadlines, rules and benchmark parameters must be captured and reviewed before submission.

lanes.title: Army decision packages
lanes.gate: Two reproducible decision demonstrations, an evidence crosswalk, independent review and a proposal draft.

requirements.requirement: Objectives, options, constraints, assumptions, risks and bias checks are explicit.
requirements.evidence: Package replay and negative contract tests
requirements.gap: Domain-expert review and official requirement confirmation

requirements.requirement: Retain changed evidence and explain a changed or unchanged decision.
requirements.evidence: Point decision and longitudinal refresh exports
requirements.gap: Real stakeholder evidence and independent verification

requirements.requirement: Separate agent proposals, independent review and human authorization.
requirements.evidence: Advisory outputs retain UNMEASURED review and PENDING approval
requirements.gap: Named receiving reviewers and approval records

requirements.requirement: Keep traceable relationships to the evidence used.
requirements.evidence: Canonical decision/observation graph with source digests
requirements.gap: External owner resolution and retained operational captures

lanes.title: DARPA market experiments
lanes.gate: A replayable market experiment, quantitative results and a separate proposal hypothesis.

requirements.requirement: Multiple agents trade in a changing simulated market.
requirements.evidence: Two assets, a public news feed, bids, uniform clearing and utility
requirements.gap: Independent experiment review and confirmed official evaluation design

requirements.requirement: Use model queries and responses without internal model access.
requirements.evidence: Scoped prompts, provider/model/version identities and replayable action receipts
requirements.gap: Authorized cross-model runs; scripted agents are synthetic controls

requirements.requirement: Measure collaboration, deception and bias with repeatable comparisons.
requirements.evidence: Raw action history and explicit UNMEASURED behavioral classification
requirements.gap: Labeled controls, classifier validation and broader stock-agent suite

lanes.title: FHERMA polynomial experiment
lanes.gate: Official correctness and benchmark receipt. Internal GO at <=2x verified leader; WATCH to 1 ms; otherwise PIVOT.

requirements.requirement: Compute an exact negacyclic polynomial product.
requirements.evidence: Carry-free integer reference and every-coefficient candidate checks
requirements.gap: Official coefficient ring, SDK and candidate interface

requirements.requirement: Submit a correct cuPQC GPU candidate for official timing.
requirements.evidence: Prerequisite doctor and supplied-timing continuation calculator
requirements.gap: GPU/cuPQC implementation, authorized official submission and timing receipts

days.title: Freeze the sources
days.army: Capture the exact notice and map requirements to existing owners and measured evidence.
days.influence: Confirm the topic and requirements; retain a separate matrix.
days.fherma: Capture live rules and starter interface; provision cuPQC and the official CLI on an authorized GPU runner.
days.output: Reviewed source captures and requirements crosswalk

days.title: Build the decision primitive
days.army: Run the strict Decision Package evaluator over one bounded comparison.
days.influence: Reuse the existing market contract and document measurement gaps.
days.fherma: Check exact CPU-reference correctness, then implement the GPU adapter against the captured official interface.
days.output: Replayable package and coefficient correctness records

days.title: Demonstrate and refresh
days.army: Retain a point decision and a changed-evidence refresh with both revisions.
days.influence: Review how independent evidence and human authority remain separate.
days.fherma: Owner submits the first correct candidate; decide GO/WATCH/PIVOT from official timing.
days.output: Two demo records and FHERMA continuation decision

days.title: Use it on BuildAndDo
days.army: Evaluate release readiness from retained acceptance evidence; hold when runtime evidence is missing.
days.influence: Define independent trial seeds, baselines and private information boundaries.
days.fherma: Continue only if the benchmark gate justifies it.
days.output: Actual repository decision package with explicit evidence gaps

days.title: Export and review
days.army: Export decision, evidence, assumptions, risk, dependency graph, source manifest, verification, approval and HTML.
days.influence: Review experimental controls before model runs.
days.fherma: Retain all attempted candidates, failures and measurements.
days.output: Replayable evidence package with review and approval gaps

days.title: Run the market seed
days.army: Resolve review findings without expanding authority.
days.influence: Run five to ten agents, two assets, private values, public news and uniform clearing.
days.fherma: Profile only on the official-compatible runner.
days.output: Synthetic baseline episodes and quantitative comparison

days.title: Compare models
days.influence: Run authorized model bindings on identical frozen datasets and seeds; retain prompts, actions, failures and identities.
days.fherma: Submit revisions only with owner authorization.
days.output: Real model receipts or explicit BLOCKED status

days.title: Challenge the evidence
days.army: Test tenant swaps, stale support, missing evidence, changed hashes, bias conflicts and self-approval attempts.
days.influence: Test malformed actions, private-information leaks, timeouts and replay tampering.
days.fherma: Test wraparound, maximum coefficients and wrong candidate outputs.
days.output: Negative-test results and retained failed experiments

days.title: Write separate proposals
days.army: Draft schema, governance, evidence, demos, milestones and commercial transition against confirmed requirements.
days.influence: Draft market, black-box interface, metrics, controls, reproducibility and scaling.
days.fherma: Describe only measured correctness and timing.
days.output: Separate Army and DARPA skeletons with unsupported claims withheld

days.title: Gate continuation
days.army: Owner reviews two demos, crosswalk, independent review and proposal gaps.
days.influence: Owner reviews experimental results and the next research hypothesis.
days.output: Evidence-backed continuation or hold for each lane
